subject: TLS sizing helpers available in n2r
body:
Added shared sizing helpers in n2r header/source for the bridge BO allocation:
- uint32_t n2r_thread_storage_shift(uint32_t bytes) = Mesa pan_get_stack_shift.
- int n2r_thread_storage_total(uint32_t bytes,uint32_t threads_per_core,uint32_t cores,uint64_t *out) = next_pow2(align16(bytes))*threads_per_core*cores; rejects bytes>32768, zero threads/cores, overflow, NULL out; bytes0 ->0.
Host test checks 16->16B/thread, 17->32, 192->192, 32768 and invalid cases. Bridge can call n2r_thread_storage_total(bytes,2048,cores,&total); it matches your existing TLS recipe. No bridge edits from me.
